Can I change the shipping address on an order I just placed?
Yes — One Fast Cat can update the shipping address until the shipping label has been created, but they can’t guarantee the change because orders are packed quickly.
Policy details:
- Address changes are possible only before the shipping label is created.
- They cannot change an order to an international address, PO Box, or non-contiguous U.S. state/territory.
- If a tracking number already exists, they can request a FedEx address correction for a $17 flat fee, but the carrier does not guarantee the change.
- A no-fee alternative after shipment may be to ask the carrier to hold the package for pickup.

Can I add an item to an order I already placed?
No. Once an order is placed, One Fast Cat cannot modify the items on the order, including adding products, removing products, or changing quantities or colors.
If the order has not shipped yet, they may be able to cancel the order so you can place a new one with the extra item. Their order changes page says they do their best, but cancellation is not guaranteed.
Policy page: https://onefastcat.com/pages/order-changes-shipping-address-changes
